description: Land Acquisition - Parapa, Rambukkana, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific plots of land being acquired by the government for public purposes. It includes descriptions of land lots, names, types (e.g., garden, paddy field), claimants, and extents. This falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters.
